'''Trippa hive''' was a [[Geonosian hive]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] where a [[Trippa hive droid factory|droid factory]] was located. Trippa hive was the site of an engagement during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] in which a [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] demolitions crew occupied the factory.<ref name="Battlefront II" />
